# Execute — `workflow execute` / continuation of `workflow run`

Use the user's instructions and relevant plan if one exists. Missing phase documents do not
block implementation. Check current code and preserve existing user changes. Establish the
relevant test baseline when needed to distinguish a regression from a pre-existing failure.

Implement a coherent slice through the boundaries required for useful behavior. Load specialized
skills only where they help. A stale optional skill path is not an execution gate; use available
guidance. If an unavailable resource contains a required contract, resolve that actual gap.

Run checks that exercise the changed behavior and affected consumers. Diagnose and fix failures
within scope; do not stop simply because a check failed. Distinguish environmental failures,
pre-existing failures, and regressions, and report any remaining limitation honestly. Broaden
checks when the integration or risk requires it; do not repeatedly run full suites after an
unchanged result without a reason.

Adapt routine implementation details using evidence. Update the plan when a material discovery
changes it; obtain a decision only for a real scope/direction ambiguity or missing authority.
Keep related contract producers, validators, consumers, and operator instructions consistent.
Local staged edits do not prove a live deployment or a successful native-runtime rehearsal.

Persist concise progress at useful checkpoints. Continue through all authorized milestones,
without waiting for approval of each file or local diff. Commit coherent verified changes when
committing is authorized. Review consequential changes using the [review guidance](phase-4-review.md)
within the run; small reversible edits need only proportionate verification. Finish with the
[wrap guidance](wrap.md), without requiring the user to invoke another phase.
